issue_context.title: PointGet will return an stale value when `tidb_enable_plan_replayer_capture` is on
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```
set @@tidb_enable_plan_replayer_capture=1;
create table t1(id int primary key, v int);
insert into t1 values(1, 10);
prepare s from 'select * from t1 where id=1';
execute s;
execute s;
update t1 set v=v+1;
execute s;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

The last `execute s` should return a row (1, 10)

```
mysql> execute s;
+----+------+
| id | v    |
+----+------+
|  1 |   11 |
+----+------+
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

It returns an stale value:

```
mysql> execute s;
+----+------+
| id | v    |
+----+------+
|  1 |   10 |
+----+------+
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

```
mysql> SELECT tidb_version();
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| tidb_version()                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Release Version: None
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: None
Git Branch: None
UTC Build Time: None
GoVersion: go1.19.4
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: 6.2.0-alpha
Check Table Before Drop: false
Store: unistore |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
```
comments:
This bug is introduced by: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/39926

When `tidb_enable_plan_replayer_capture` is ON, it will invoke `TxnManager.GetStmtReadTS` which will fetch TSO from PD instead of using maxTS. However, in this case, point get's optimization will be used and an executor with a stale TSO will be cached.

> This bug is introduced by: #39926
> 
> When `tidb_enable_plan_replayer_capture` is ON, it will invoke `TxnManager.GetStmtReadTS` which will fetch TSO from PD instead of using maxTS. However, in this case, point get's optimization will be used and an executor with a stale TSO will be cached.

Why does a GetStmtReadTS call have impact to the runtime behavior?

This behavior is inherited from the old implement. But I think it is logically right, GetStmtReadTS returns the txn's start ts, we need to activate a txn so that we can know what its value is.
Confirmed the issue does not exist on old versions, remove affects.

During oncall, we found `tidb_enable_plan_replayer_capture = on` is not the only case that cache a PointGetExecutor with ts != maxint64, there might be some other cases trigger the bug.

The fix PR can solve all the bugs of this kind, let's cherry-pick it to some release branches.

review_comments:
Could you add some comments around [the definition of `PlanCacheStmt.Executor`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/planner/core/plan_cache_utils.go#L412) as well to indicate there is a dangerous assumption that the cached Executor always uses `MaxTS`?
I guess no one knows this assumption before this issue... 😨
If `IsPlanReplayerCaptureEnabled` is true, it will invoke `GetReadStmt` and activate the txn. Moving `OptimizeWithPlanAndThenWarmUp` here is to keep the pointget still be optimized before it.
Better to add some comments about this constraint here or the possible implicit activation on the interface `GetStmtReadTS` and `GetStmtForUpdateTS`.
